description: the font and settings used to render the job title at the top of the plot. If a plot name s is not specified, the current view is assumed.

keywords.name: active
keywords.description: Draw the job title on or off.

notes: The manual's 'text' token is a font block: the live keywords are active, color, family, size and style (no free text argument). The job-title text itself comes from the project settings, not from this command.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on the PFC3D 6.00 and 9.8 GUIs (syntax grade): the font-block keywords accepted and a free text argument rejected (with the font-block enumeration) on both GUIs.
